title: What If Wikipedia Went Dark for a Day? It Did in 2012

scenes.text: What if Wikipedia switched itself off for a whole day? On January 18, 2012, it did.
English Wikipedia went dark for 24 hours. About 162 million people saw the blackout page instead of an article.
About 75,000 other websites joined the protest against two US anti-piracy bills.
More than 8 million Americans used the blackout page to look up their members of Congress.
Over 2.4 million tweets about the bills were posted in just sixteen hours.
Within days, dozens of senators had come out against the bills, including former co-sponsors.

description:
What if Wikipedia went dark for a day?
In 2012 it did, and 162 million people saw the blackout page.
What should we run through next?
